The 2019-2020 tax brackets for single individuals is as follows.

Amount Tax Rate
Up to $9,700 10%
$9,701 - $39,475 12%
$39,476 - $84,200 22%
$84,201 - $160,725 24%
$160,726 - $204,100 32%
$204,101 - $510,300 35%
Over $510,300 37%

So to figure out how much in taxes you pay, you take your taxable income and divide it up into those brackets.
